title: Get Live Room Product Stats
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202502/live_rooms/{live_room_id}/product_stats

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns product performance statistics for the specified live room, including product IDs, names, GMV, unit price, inventory counts, and click counts. The live room must belong to the creator associated with the access token.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
live_room_id string Y 7494534671928321024 live stream room id

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202502/live_rooms/7494534671928321024/product_stats?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^product_stats []object Statistics for each product in the specified live room.
^^main_image_url string https://example.com/images/products/1732333333333333629-main.jpg The main image of product URL
^^product_id string 1732333333333333629 Unique ID for each product
^^is_live bool true If the item is currently on sale in the livestream room
^^click_through_rate string 0.11 The ratio of product clicks to product impressions
^^sellable_region string ID The region where products sells
^^created_order_count int 123 The number of orders created for this product by users from the livestream
^^exposure_count int 123 The number of impressions of this product, including in the product list and product cards
^^total_click_count int 123 The total number of times the product was clicked from this livestream, including from the product list and product card
^^local_gmv object The revenue of products using local currency
^^^amount string 123.45 The amount of GMV
^^^currency string USD The ISO 4217 currency code for the GMV amount.
^^product_name string Wireless Charging Stand The display name of the product in the live room product stats list.
^^local_unit_price object The average price of the units sold using local currency
^^^amount string 12.34 The amount of unit price
^^^currency string USD The ISO 4217 currency code for the unit price amount.
^^paid_order_count int 123 The number of SKU orders created and paid by users for this product from the livestream room
^^inventory_left_count int 123 The remaining inventory of the product
^^inventory_consumption_count int 123 The number of product units sold
^^created_order_user_count int 123 Number of unique users who created orders for this product
^^paid_user_count int 123 Number of unique users who paid orders for this product
^^click_order_rate string 0.11 Product paid SKU orders/Product clicks
